note.question: What determines the optimal consolidation policy focusing on the trade-off between economies of scale due to combining orders and expedited shipping costs, in the setting of two warehouses?
note.overview: Shipment consolidation (i.e., shipping multiple orders together instead of shipping them separately) is commonly used to decrease total shipping costs. However, when the delivery of some orders is delayed, so they can be consolidated with future orders, a more expensive expedited shipment may be needed to meet shorter deadlines. In this paper, we study the optimal consolidation policy focusing on the trade-off between economies of scale due to combining orders and expedited shipping costs, in the setting of two warehouses.
